asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Separately shuffle asset, demand, event and investment decks, and the five action-type decks (construction, biotech, labor, media and security).

whole_entry_support.quote: Shuffle assets, demands, events and investments separately.
Separate actions into their five types and shuffle each into its own deck beside its matching slot.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Random setup card determines listed city placements and facedown asset count in ascending turn slots; box all setup cards.

whole_entry_support.quote: Shuffle setup cards and draw one. For every component listed, place one copy in each listed district. Take the number of assets printed in the setup card's upper-right corner from the asset deck and place them facedown, one per turn-track slot, starting at slot 1. Return all setup cards to the box.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Round 1, resources 0, threat 0; reveal demand and set its target tokens.

whole_entry_support.quote: Put the round marker at 1 and each resource at 0. Reveal the top demand. Set each target token to the printed amount on its resource track.
Set threat to 0.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Choose corporations, matching faceup emergencies and correct player-count sheet sides; draw initial sheet cards.

whole_entry_support.quote: Each player chooses a corporation, taking its sheet and matching emergency action faceup. Use the side marked with the four-player icon at four players; otherwise use the five/six-player side.
Each player draws the number/types on their sheet, using its printed top-to-bottom order and the General rule below.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Randomly select a capital token to choose the active player, who starts at 10 capital; clockwise players start at 11, 12, and so on.

whole_entry_support.quote: Randomly select one participating capital token. That corporation takes the active-player token. Set threat to 0. The active player starts at 10 capital; proceeding clockwise, the others start at 11, 12, 13, and so on.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Use participating-corporation rivals plus Federalist; secretly deal one each and put extra partly under board.

whole_entry_support.quote: Shuffle the participating corporations' rival cards together with the Federalist. Deal one facedown to each player; place the extra facedown and partly under the board. Secretly inspect your own rival without revealing or discussing it.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Each draws two investments, keeps one facedown and returns other facedown to top; form reserve.

whole_entry_support.quote: Each player draws two investments, keeps one facedown in their play area, and returns the other facedown to the top of the investment deck. Do not reveal the rejected card.
Sort unused android, outage, unrest, illness and development tokens and Human First, orgcrime and prisec units into piles beside the board.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Start-of-turn assets resolve before Refresh.

whole_entry_support.quote: Resolve assets that trigger **at the start of your turn**, before Refresh.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Refresh readies exhausted assets, then draws sheet cards; resolve one deal.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Optional End of Turn abilities each once, then active player discards to ordinary hand limit five, excluding emergencies, then passes left.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Empty turn track at turn end ends Action Phase and leads to Production.

whole_entry_support.quote: If no assets remain on the turn track at the end of the turn, the Action Phase ends.
The last deal still has its full end-of-turn step before Production begins.

asked_fact_assessments.asked_fact: Turn count comes from setup/event, so some players can receive no turn that round.

whole_entry_support.quote: The setup card sets the first Action Phase's turn count; subsequent events set later turn counts. Some players may get no turn in a particular round.
